description: Source file defining the CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI class, which handles REST API endpoints for scheduling, retrieving, and updating candidate interviews within a recruitment plugin of an HR management system (OrangeHRM). It includes methods for validation, transaction management, and accessing related entities like CandidateVacancy and Interview.

classes.name: CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing candidate interview scheduling, including creating, retrieving, updating, with validation, authorization, and transaction management.

methods.description: Throws not implemented exception for validation rules for getAll.
